text: dsh-plugin-android-vscreen 是一款 DSH 安卓设备控制插件，通过 DSH 工具接口接入 Android 虚拟显示器。它可检查 adb 或手机本地桥连接状态，创建虚拟屏并启动指定应用，截取虚拟屏画面为 PNG，也能按坐标点按、滑动并关闭虚拟屏。插件将设备操作交给随包核心处理，支持电脑端 adb 与手机端桥接两种方式。适合希望让 DSH agent 操作安卓应用、同时继续使用手机物理屏幕的场景。使用需有可访问的 Android 设备和 adb 或手机端 DSH 特权桥；不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-plugin-android-vscreen lets a DSH agent operate Android apps on a virtual display. Tools create displays, launch apps, capture PNGs, tap, swipe, and close displays. It connects by desktop adb or phone-side bridge. Requires an accessible Android device and either transport; no API key.
想让 DSH agent 在手机的虚拟屏里打开并操作安卓应用。
需要让 AI 截取安卓虚拟屏画面，再按坐标点击或滑动。
I want my DSH agent to interact with Android apps on a virtual display while I keep using the phone screen.
dsh-plugin-android-vscreen 的功能「虚拟屏交互」：为安卓设备创建虚拟显示器，可选启动指定应用，并提供虚拟屏截图、坐标点按、滑动和关闭操作。通过对应的 DSH 工具触发，截图以 PNG 路径返回。

dsh-plugin-android-vscreen README · Why：Most "agent drives my phone" plugins tap the **main screen**: your phone is hijacked while the agent
works — you can't use it, and it can't be used quietly in the background.

dsh-plugin-android-vscreen README · Why：Android can create a **virtual display**: a second, invisible screen. The agent launches an app onto
that display, looks at it and taps it there, while the physical screen keeps doing whatever you were
doing. Every action reports a "main-screen proof" (`mainBefore` → `mainAfter`) so you can see the
physical screen was not touched.

dsh-plugin-android-vscreen README · ⚠️ A virtual display isolates the **picture**, not the **effects** / 只隔离画面，不隔离副作用：An app running on a virtual display still acts on the **whole device**. Tap *Airplane mode*, *Wi-Fi*
or *Do not disturb* inside a virtual display and that switch really flips — it is the same system
setting. Installing, sending messages, changing settings: all real.

So *"your screen stays untouched"* is **not** the same as *"your device stays untouched"*.
section: ⚠️ A virtual display isolates the **picture**, not the **effects** / 只隔离画面，不隔离副作用

dsh-plugin-android-vscreen README · ⚠️ A virtual display isolates the **picture**, not the **effects** / 只隔离画面，不隔离副作用：**Rule for agents using this plugin:** take a frame with `android_vscreen_see` first, and derive tap
coordinates from what you actually see. Never tap a guessed fraction of the screen.

text:
dsh-plugin-android-vscreen README · Tools：| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `android_vscreen_doctor` | Can I drive this device, and over which transport. Run it first. |
| `android_vscreen_status` | Is a virtual display running, and how big is it. |
| `android_vscreen_start` | Create the virtual display and optionally launch an app onto it. |
| `android_vscreen_see` | Grab a frame of the *virtual* display as a PNG. |
| `android_vscreen_tap` | Tap on the virtual display. |
| `android_vscreen_swipe` | Swipe on the virtual display. |
| `android_vscreen_close` | Destroy the virtual display. |

dsh-plugin-android-vscreen README · How it reaches the phone：Two transports, picked automatically:

| Transport | When it's used |
|---|---|
| `adb` | DSH runs on your computer (USB or wireless debugging) |
| local bridge (`127.0.0.1:3081`) | DSH runs **on the phone itself** (e.g. the Android build) |

dsh-plugin-android-vscreen README · How it reaches the phone：Both end up as a shell on the device — the same privilege level `adb shell` has. That privilege is
required: an app cannot put *another* app onto a virtual display with its own identity, so the
bundled core runs as `shell` via `app_process`. It uses only public Android APIs
(`DisplayManager.createVirtualDisplay`, `ImageReader`) plus documented reflection constants — **no
MediaProjection**, no screen-capture permission dialog.

text:
dsh-plugin-android-vscreen README · Requirements：- An Android device reachable by `adb` (USB or `adb connect`), **or** DSH running on the phone with
  its privileged shell bridge available.
- Node.js 20+ (whatever your DSH runs on).

dsh-plugin-android-vscreen README · Development：The device side is a small Java program in `assets/vscreen-core.jar`. To rebuild it from source, see
the Android port repository (`android-app/src/com/deepseek/harness/vscreen/`). Two smoke tests run
the whole chain without going through a model:

```sh
node test-m1.mjs            # create → launch → see → tap → see → main-screen proof → close
node vs-safe.mjs start      # same thing, but aimed at a harmless target
```
